ko.title: 세 개의 기지, 한 번의 보복: 이란의 걸프 지역 미군 기지 공습 내부

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## 걸프 지역의 급격한 긴장 고조

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: 이란이 요르단, 쿠웨이트, 바레인에 있는 미군 시설을 겨냥해 일련의 공습을 감행한 후 워싱턴과 테헤란 간의 긴장이 위험한 새로운 국면에 접어들었습니다.

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: 지역 및 국제 매체가 인용한 당국자들에 따르면, 이란 국영 언론은 이번 행동이 미국의 라락섬 공습과 케르만샤주에서의 이슬람혁명수비대(IRGC) 인원 사망에 대한 보복이라고 보도했습니다.

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: 사건의 전말은 독립적으로 검증하기가 여전히 어렵고, 양국 정부는 이번 충돌을 촉발한 원인에 대해 서로 다른 주장을 내놓고 있습니다.

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: 분명한 것은 상황이 국지적인 사건에서 더 넓은 지역에 영향을 미치는 사건으로 빠르게 전환되었다는 점입니다.

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## 보도된 내용

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: 이란의 당국자와 국영 매체들은 미군과 연계된 3개 기지에 대한 공습이 전면전의 시작이라기보다는 계산된 제한적 대응이라고 규정했습니다. 이는 양국 간에 과거에 있었던 상호 비방 및 신호 보내기 국면을 연상시키는 표현입니다.

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: 미 국방부 당국자들은 걸프 지역 시설에 대한 피격 사실을 인정했으나 인명 피해나 재산 피해의 전체 규모는 아직 확인되지 않았다고 밝혔으며, 평가는 진행 중이라고 당부했습니다.

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: 분석가들은 미국의 공습, 이란인 사상자 발생, 그리고 미 본토에 대한 직접적인 공습보다는 미군 주둔지를 겨냥한 이란의 조율된 대응이라는 이러한 패턴이 이 지역에서의 이전 대치 국면과 닮아 있다고 지적합니다.

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: 이번 공습이 이대로 통제 범위 내에 머물 것인지, 아니면 추가 세력을 끌어들일 것인지는 워싱턴, 테헤란, 그리고 동맹 관계에 있는 걸프 지역 수도들의 정책 입안자들에게 핵심적인 질문으로 남아 있습니다.

segments.src: ## Markets React Instantly
segments.tr: ## 즉각 반응하는 시장

segments.src: Financial markets moved within minutes of the news breaking.
segments.tr: 금융 시장은 뉴스 보도 후 몇 분 만에 움직였습니다.

segments.src: Benchmark oil prices climbed as traders priced in the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and production in a region that accounts for a significant share of global crude supply.
segments.tr: 전 세계 원유 공급량의 상당 부분을 차지하는 지역에서 해상 운송 차질과 생산 차질의 위험을 트레이더들이 가격에 반영함에 따라 벤치마크 유가가 상승했습니다.

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for a large portion of the world's seaborne oil trade, is once again at the center of investor concern.
segments.tr: 세계 해상 원유 교역량의 상당 부분이 통과하는 요충지인 호르무즈 해협이 다시 한번 투자자들의 관심의 중심에 서 있습니다.

segments.src: Cryptocurrency markets, often treated by traders as a barometer of risk appetite, fell sharply in tandem.
segments.tr: 트레이더들이 위험 선호도의 지표로 자주 취급하는 암호화폐 시장도 이에 발맞추어 급락했습니다.

segments.src: Bitcoin and other major digital assets saw notable declines as investors rotated toward traditional safe havens such as gold and the US dollar.
segments.tr: 투자자들이 금이나 미 달러 같은 전통적인 안전자산으로 자금을 이동시키면서 비트코인 및 기타 주요 디지털 자산이 눈에 띄게 하락했습니다.

segments.src: Equity futures in the US and Asia also wobbled in early trading, reflecting broader unease about the potential for a wider Gulf conflict.
segments.tr: 미국과 아시아의 주가지수 선물도 장 초반에 흔들리며 걸프 지역 분쟁 확산 가능성에 대한 광범위한 불안감을 반영했습니다.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond the Region
segments.tr: ## 지역을 넘어 이것이 중요한 이유

segments.src: Even short of a full-scale war, sustained instability in the Gulf carries outsized economic consequences.
segments.tr: 전면전까지는 아니더라도 걸프 지역의 지속적인 불안정은 막대한 경제적 여파를 동반합니다.

segments.src: Higher oil prices tend to filter through to fuel and transportation costs worldwide, adding pressure to inflation figures that many central banks have been working to bring down.
segments.tr: 유가 상승은 전 세계 연료 및 운송 비용에 전가되는 경향이 있으며, 많은 중앙은행이 낮추기 위해 노력해 온 인플레이션 수치에 압박을 가중시킵니다.

segments.src: A prolonged standoff could also complicate diplomatic efforts elsewhere, including nuclear negotiations and regional ceasefire arrangements that have periodically stalled and restarted in recent years.
segments.tr: 또한 장기화된 대치는 최근 몇 년간 주기적으로 중단과 재개를 반복해 온 핵 협상 및 지역 휴전 협정을 포함하여 다른 지역의 외교적 노력을 복잡하게 만들 수 있습니다.

segments.src: ## A Fluid, Fast-Moving Situation
segments.tr: ## 유동적이고 빠르게 전개되는 상황

segments.src: Details continue to emerge, and early reports from conflict zones are frequently revised as more information becomes available.
segments.tr: 세부 사항은 계속해서 드러나고 있으며, 더 많은 정보가 제공됨에 따라 분쟁 지역의 초기 보도는 빈번하게 수정되고 있습니다.

segments.src: Government spokespeople on both sides have urged caution against premature conclusions, while allied nations in the Gulf Cooperation Council have called for restraint and de-escalation.
segments.tr: 양측의 정부 대변인들은 성급한 결론을 내리지 말라고 촉구한 반면, 걸프협력회의(GCC) 소속 동맹국들은 자제와 긴장 완화를 촉구했습니다.

segments.src: For now, markets and diplomats alike are watching for the next signal — whether from Tehran, Washington, or the bases themselves — that will determine if this remains a contained exchange or the start of a broader confrontation.
segments.tr: 현재 시장과 외교관들은 테헤란, 워싱턴, 혹은 기지 자체로부터 이번 사태가 통제된 교전에 그칠지 아니면 더 넓은 대립의 시작이 될지를 결정할 다음 신호를 주시하고 있습니다.

segments.src: Readers should treat early casualty and damage figures as preliminary until confirmed by multiple independent sources.
segments.tr: 독자들은 여러 독립 출처에 의해 확인될 때까지 초기 사상자 및 피해 수치를 예비적인 것으로 취급해야 합니다.

zh.title: 三个基地，一次报复：深度解析伊朗对海湾美军的袭击

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## 海湾局势急剧升级

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: 在伊朗对位于约旦、科威特和巴林的美军军事设施发动一波袭击后，华盛顿与德黑兰之间的紧张局势已进入危险的新阶段。

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: 根据区域和国际媒体引用的官员说法，伊朗官方媒体将此次行动描述为对美军袭击拉拉克岛（Larak Island）以及伊斯兰革命卫队（IRGC）人员在克尔曼沙赫省（Kermanshah province）死亡的报复。

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: 事件的经过仍难以独立核实，两国政府对引发此次交火的原因给出了不同的说法。

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: 显而易见的是，局势已迅速从局部事件演变成影响更广泛地区的危机。

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## 据报道发生了什么

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: 伊朗官员和国家相关媒体将对三个美军相关基地的袭击描述为经过精算的有限回应，而非全面战争的开端——这种表述让人联想起两国以往针锋相对的信号传递。

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: 美国国防官员已承认海湾地区的设施遭到袭击，但尚未确认伤亡或损失的完整范围，并警告称评估工作仍在进行中。

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: 分析人士指出，这种模式——美军袭击、伊朗人员伤亡、随后伊朗对美国阵地进行有限度的回应而非直接打击美国本土——与该地区此前几轮对抗如出一辙。

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: 本轮冲突是会得到控制，还是会将更多参与方卷入其中，仍是华盛顿、德黑兰以及海湾盟国决策者面临的核心问题。

segments.src: ## Markets React Instantly
segments.tr: ## 市场迅速作出反应

segments.src: Financial markets moved within minutes of the news breaking.
segments.tr: 消息传出后数分钟内，金融市场便作出了反应。

segments.src: Benchmark oil prices climbed as traders priced in the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and production in a region that accounts for a significant share of global crude supply.
segments.tr: 基准原油价格上涨，因为交易员将全球原油供应占比较大的地区航道和生产面临中断的风险计入了价格。

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for a large portion of the world's seaborne oil trade, is once again at the center of investor concern.
segments.tr: 霍尔木兹海峡作为全球大部分海上原油贸易的咽喉要道，再次成为投资者关注的焦点。

segments.src: Cryptocurrency markets, often treated by traders as a barometer of risk appetite, fell sharply in tandem.
segments.tr: 通常被交易员视为风险偏好晴雨表加密货币市场也同步大幅下跌。

segments.src: Bitcoin and other major digital assets saw notable declines as investors rotated toward traditional safe havens such as gold and the US dollar.
segments.tr: 由于投资者转向黄金和美元等传统避险资产，比特币和其他主要数字资产出现显著下跌。

segments.src: Equity futures in the US and Asia also wobbled in early trading, reflecting broader unease about the potential for a wider Gulf conflict.
segments.tr: 美国和亚洲的股指期货也在早盘交易中出现波动，反映出市场对海湾冲突扩大的潜在风险感到普遍不安。

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond the Region
segments.tr: ## 为何影响超出该地区

segments.src: Even short of a full-scale war, sustained instability in the Gulf carries outsized economic consequences.
segments.tr: 即使没有爆发全面战争，海湾地区持续的不稳定也会带来巨大的经济后果。

segments.src: Higher oil prices tend to filter through to fuel and transportation costs worldwide, adding pressure to inflation figures that many central banks have been working to bring down.
segments.tr: 较高的油价往往会传导至全球的燃料和运输成本，从而对许多央行一直努力降低通胀数据的努力施加额外压力。

segments.src: A prolonged standoff could also complicate diplomatic efforts elsewhere, including nuclear negotiations and regional ceasefire arrangements that have periodically stalled and restarted in recent years.
segments.tr: 长期的僵局还可能使其他方面的外交努力变得复杂，包括近年来屡次停滞又重启的核谈判和区域停火协议。

segments.src: ## A Fluid, Fast-Moving Situation
segments.tr: ## 局势瞬息万变

segments.src: Details continue to emerge, and early reports from conflict zones are frequently revised as more information becomes available.
segments.tr: 细节仍在不断浮现，随着更多信息的获取，冲突地区的早期报道经常会被修正。

segments.src: Government spokespeople on both sides have urged caution against premature conclusions, while allied nations in the Gulf Cooperation Council have called for restraint and de-escalation.
segments.tr: 双方政府发言人都呼吁对过早下结论保持谨慎，而海湾阿拉伯国家合作委员会的盟国则呼吁克制与降温。

segments.src: For now, markets and diplomats alike are watching for the next signal — whether from Tehran, Washington, or the bases themselves — that will determine if this remains a contained exchange or the start of a broader confrontation.
segments.tr: 目前，市场和外交官都在等待下一个信号——无论是来自德黑兰、华盛顿还是基地本身——这将决定这仍然是一次受控的交火，还是更大规模对抗的开始。

segments.src: Readers should treat early casualty and damage figures as preliminary until confirmed by multiple independent sources.
segments.tr: 读者应将早期的伤亡和损毁数据视为初步数据，直到获得多个独立来源的确认。

hi.title: तीन ठिकाने, एक प्रतिशोध: खाड़ी में अमेरिकी बलों पर ईरान के हमलों का विश्लेषण

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## खाड़ी में तेजी से बढ़ता तनाव

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: ईरान द्वारा जॉर्डन, कुवैत और बहरीन में अमेरिकी सैन्य ठिकानों को निशाना बनाकर हमलों की एक लहर शुरू करने के बाद वाशिंगटन और तेहरान के बीच तनाव एक खतरनाक नए चरण में प्रवेश कर गया है।

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: क्षेत्रीय और अंतर्राष्ट्रीय मीडिया द्वारा उद्धृत अधिकारियों के अनुसार, ईरानी राज्य मीडिया ने इस कार्रवाई को लारक द्वीप पर अमेरिकी हमले और केरमनशाह प्रांत में इस्लामिक रिवोल्यूशनरी गार्ड कॉर्प्स (IRGC) के कर्मियों की मौत के प्रतिशोध के रूप में वर्णित किया है।

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: घटनाओं के क्रम को स्वतंत्र रूप से सत्यापित करना कठिन बना हुआ है, और दोनों सरकारों ने इस बात के अलग-अलग विवरण दिए हैं कि इस संघर्ष की शुरुआत कैसे हुई।

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: यह स्पष्ट है कि स्थिति एक स्थानीय घटना से तेजी से बदलकर व्यापक क्षेत्र के लिए प्रभाव डालने वाली बन गई है।

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## क्या हुआ था (रिपोर्टों के अनुसार)

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: ईरान के अधिकारियों और राज्य से जुड़े मीडिया ने तीन अमेरिकी ठिकानों पर हुए हमलों को एक व्यापक युद्ध की शुरुआत के बजाय एक सोची-समझी, सीमित प्रतिक्रिया के रूप में वर्णित किया — यह भाषा दोनों देशों के बीच जैसे को तैसा देने वाले पिछले मामलों की याद दिलाती है।

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.

es.title: Tres bases, una represalia: Dentro de los ataques de Irán contra las fuerzas de EE. UU. en el Golfo

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## Una rápida escalada en el Golfo

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Las tensiones entre Washington y Teherán han entrado en una nueva y peligrosa fase después de que Irán lanzara una ola de ataques contra instalaciones militares estadounidenses en Jordania, Kuwait y Baréin.

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: Según funcionarios citados por medios regionales e internacionales, la acción fue descrita por los medios estatales iraníes como una represalia por un ataque de EE. UU. en la isla de Larak y la muerte de personal del Cuerpo de la Guardia Revolucionaria Islámica (IRGC) en la provincia de Kermanshah.

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: La secuencia de los hechos sigue siendo difícil de verificar de forma independiente, y ambos gobiernos han ofrecido versiones diferentes sobre qué desencadenó el intercambio.

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: Lo que está claro es que la situación ha pasado rápidamente de ser un incidente localizado a uno con implicaciones para la región en su conjunto.

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## Lo que según se informa sucedió

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: Funcionarios y medios afiliados al Estado en Irán caracterizaron los ataques contra las tres bases vinculadas a EE. UU. como una respuesta calculada y limitada, en lugar del primer movimiento de una guerra más amplia, un lenguaje que recuerda a episodios pasados de señales de toma y daca entre ambos países.

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: Funcionarios de defensa de EE. UU. han reconocido haber recibido fuego en instalaciones de la región del Golfo, pero aún no han confirmado el alcance total de las bajas o los daños, advirtiendo que las evaluaciones siguen en curso.

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: Los analistas señalan que este patrón —un ataque de EE. UU., bajas iraníes y luego una respuesta iraní calibrada contra posiciones estadounidenses en lugar de ataques directos al territorio de EE. UU.— tiene ecos de rondas anteriores de confrontación en la región.

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: Si esta ronda se mantiene contenida o arrastra a actores adicionales sigue siendo la cuestión central para los responsables de la toma de decisiones en Washington, Teherán y las capitales aliadas del Golfo.

segments.tr: El estrecho de Ormuz, un punto de estrangulamiento para una gran parte del comercio marítimo mundial de petróleo, se encuentra una vez más en el centro de la preocupación de los inversores.

fr.title: Trois bases, une riposte : Au cœur des frappes de l'Iran contre les forces américaines dans le Golfe

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## Une escalade rapide dans le Golfe

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Les tensions entre Washington et Téhéran sont entrées dans une nouvelle phase dangereuse après que l'Iran a lancé une vague de frappes ciblant des installations militaires américaines en Jordanie, au Koweït et à Bahreïn.

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: Selon des responsables cités par des médias régionaux et internationaux, l'action a été qualifiée par les médias d'État iraniens de riposte à une frappe américaine sur l'île de Larak et à la mort de membres du Corps des gardiens de la révolution islamique (CGRI) dans la province de Kermanshah.

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: L'enchaînement des événements reste difficile à vérifier de manière indépendante, et les deux gouvernements ont présenté des versions divergentes sur ce qui a déclenché cet échange.

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: Ce qui est clair, c'est que la situation est passée rapidement d'un incident localisé à une crise ayant des répercussions pour l'ensemble de la région.

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## Ce qui se serait passé

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: Les responsables et les médias affiliés à l'État en Iran ont qualifié les frappes sur les trois bases liées aux États-Unis de réponse calculée et limitée, plutôt que de premier acte d'une guerre plus large — un discours qui rappelle les précédents épisodes de signalement de type œil pour œil entre les deux pays.

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: Les responsables de la défense américaine ont reconnu des tirs entrants sur des installations dans la région du Golfe, mais n'ont pas encore confirmé l'ampleur totale des pertes ou des dégâts, avertissant que les évaluations sont en cours.

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: Les analystes soulignent que ce schéma — une frappe américaine, des pertes iraniennes, puis une réponse iranienne calibrée contre des positions américaines plutôt que des frappes directes sur le territoire américain — fait écho aux précédents cycles de confrontation dans la région.

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: La question centrale pour les décideurs politiques à Washington, Téhéran et dans les capitales alliées du Golfe reste de savoir si ce cycle restera contenu ou s'il entraînera d'autres acteurs.

segments.src: ## Markets React Instantly
segments.tr: ## Les marchés réagissent instantanément

segments.src: Financial markets moved within minutes of the news breaking.
segments.tr: Les marchés financiers ont réagi quelques minutes seulement après l'annonce de la nouvelle.

segments.src: Benchmark oil prices climbed as traders priced in the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and production in a region that accounts for a significant share of global crude supply.
segments.tr: Les prix de référence du pétrole ont grimpé, les traders intégrant le risque de perturbation des voies maritimes et de la production dans une région qui représente une part importante de l'approvisionnement mondial en brut.

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for a large portion of the world's seaborne oil trade, is once again at the center of investor concern.
segments.tr: Le détroit d'Ormuz, un point de passage stratégique pour une grande partie du commerce maritime mondial de pétrole, est une fois de plus au centre des préoccupations des investisseurs.

segments.src: Cryptocurrency markets, often treated by traders as a barometer of risk appetite, fell sharply in tandem.
segments.tr: Les marchés des cryptomonnaies, souvent considérés par les traders comme un baromètre de l'appétit pour le risque, ont chuté brutalement en tandem.

segments.src: Bitcoin and other major digital assets saw notable declines as investors rotated toward traditional safe havens such as gold and the US dollar.
segments.tr: Le Bitcoin et d'autres actifs numériques majeurs ont enregistré des baisses notables, les investisseurs se tournant vers des valeurs refuges traditionnelles telles que l'or et le dollar américain.

segments.src: Equity futures in the US and Asia also wobbled in early trading, reflecting broader unease about the potential for a wider Gulf conflict.
segments.tr: Les contrats à terme sur actions aux États-Unis et en Asie ont également vacillé lors des premiers échanges, reflétant une inquiétude plus large quant au risque d'un conflit étendu dans le Golfe.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond the Region
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cela importe au-delà de la région

segments.src: Even short of a full-scale war, sustained instability in the Gulf carries outsized economic consequences.
segments.tr: Même sans aller jusqu'à une guerre totale, une instabilité prolongée dans le Golfe entraîne des conséquences économiques démesurées.

segments.src: Higher oil prices tend to filter through to fuel and transportation costs worldwide, adding pressure to inflation figures that many central banks have been working to bring down.
segments.tr: La hausse des prix du pétrole a tendance à se répercuter sur les coûts du carburant et du transport dans le monde entier, accentuant la pression sur les chiffres de l'inflation que de nombreuses banques centrales s'efforcent de faire baisser.

segments.src: A prolonged standoff could also complicate diplomatic efforts elsewhere, including nuclear negotiations and regional ceasefire arrangements that have periodically stalled and restarted in recent years.
segments.tr: Un bras de fer prolongé pourrait également compliquer les efforts diplomatiques ailleurs, notamment les négociations sur le nucléaire et les accords de cessez-le-feu régionaux qui ont périodiquement calé et repris ces dernières années.

segments.src: ## A Fluid, Fast-Moving Situation
segments.tr: ## Une situation fluide et évolutive

segments.src: Details continue to emerge, and early reports from conflict zones are frequently revised as more information becomes available.
segments.tr: Les détails continuent d'apparaître, et les premiers rapports en provenance des zones de conflit sont fréquemment révisés à mesure que de plus amples informations deviennent disponibles.

segments.src: Government spokespeople on both sides have urged caution against premature conclusions, while allied nations in the Gulf Cooperation Council have called for restraint and de-escalation.
segments.tr: Les porte-paroles des gouvernements des deux côtés ont appelé à la prudence face aux conclusions prématurées, tandis que les nations alliées du Conseil de coopération du Golfe ont appelé à la retenue et à la désescalade.

segments.src: For now, markets and diplomats alike are watching for the next signal — whether from Tehran, Washington, or the bases themselves — that will determine if this remains a contained exchange or the start of a broader confrontation.
segments.tr: Pour l'instant, les marchés comme les diplomates attendent le prochain signal — qu'il vienne de Téhéran, de Washington ou des bases elles-mêmes — qui déterminera s'il s'agit d'un échange contenu ou du début d'une confrontation plus large.

segments.src: Readers should treat early casualty and damage figures as preliminary until confirmed by multiple independent sources.
segments.tr: Les lecteurs doivent considérer les premiers chiffres concernant les pertes et les dégâts comme préliminaires jusqu'à ce qu'ils soient confirmés par de multiples sources indépendantes.

in.title: Tiga Pangkalan, Satu Pembalasan: Di Dalam Serangan Iran terhadap Pasukan AS di Teluk

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## Eskalasi Cepat di Teluk

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Ketegangan antara Washington dan Teheran telah memasuki fase baru yang berbahaya setelah Iran meluncurkan gelombang serangan yang menargetkan instalasi militer Amerika di Yordania, Kuwait, dan Bahrain.

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: Urutan kejadian masih sulit diverifikasi secara independen, dan kedua pemerintah telah memberikan penjelasan yang berbeda mengenai apa yang memicu pertukaran tersebut.

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## Apa yang Dilaporkan Terjadi

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: Para pejabat dan media yang berafiliasi dengan pemerintah di Iran mencirikan serangan terhadap ketiga pangkalan yang terkait dengan AS sebagai respons yang terhitung dan terbatas daripada langkah awal perang yang lebih luas — bahasa yang mengingatkan pada episode masa lalu dari sinyal saling balas antara kedua negara.

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: Para pejabat pertahanan AS telah mengakui adanya tembakan yang masuk di fasilitas-fasilitas di wilayah Teluk tetapi belum mengkonfirmasi cakupan penuh dari korban jiwa atau kerusakan, dengan memperingatkan bahwa penilaian sedang berlangsung.

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: Para analis mencatat bahwa pola ini — serangan AS, korban dari pihak Iran, kemudian respons terukur Iran terhadap posisi Amerika daripada serangan langsung ke tanah air AS — memiliki gaung dari babak konfrontasi sebelumnya di kawasan tersebut.

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: Apakah babak ini akan tetap terkandung atau menarik aktor tambahan tetap menjadi pertanyaan utama bagi para pembuat kebijakan di Washington, Teheran, dan ibu kota Teluk yang bersekutu.

segments.src: ## Markets React Instantly
segments.tr: ## Pasar Bereaksi Seketika

segments.tr: Pasar keuangan bergerak dalam hitungan menit setelah berita tersebut pecah.

segments.src: Benchmark oil prices climbed as traders priced in the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and production in a region that accounts for a significant share of global crude supply.
segments.tr: Harga minyak acuan naik karena para pedagang memperhitungkan risiko gangguan pada jalur pelayaran dan produksi di wilayah yang menyumbang porsi signifikan dari pasokan minyak mentah global.

segments.tr: Pasar mata uang kripto, yang sering dianggap oleh para pedagang sebagai barometer nafsu risiko, turun tajam secara bersamaan.

segments.src: Equity futures in the US and Asia also wobbled in early trading, reflecting broader unease about the potential for a wider Gulf conflict.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond the Region

segments.src: A prolonged standoff could also complicate diplomatic efforts elsewhere, including nuclear negotiations and regional ceasefire arrangements that have periodically stalled and restarted in recent years.

segments.tr: Untuk saat ini, pasar dan para diplomat sama-sama mengawasi sinyal berikutnya — baik dari Teheran, Washington, maupun pangkalan itu sendiri — yang akan menentukan apakah ini tetap menjadi pertukaran yang terkandung atau awal dari konfrontasi yang lebih luas.

ja.title: 3つの基地、1回の報復：湾岸地域における米軍に対するイランの攻撃の背景

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## 湾岸地域における急激なエスカレーション

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: イランがヨルダン、クウェート、バーレーンにある米軍施設を標的に一連の攻撃を開始したことで、ワシントンとテヘラン間の緊張は危険な新たな段階に入った。

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: 地域および国際的な報道機関が引用した当局者によると、この行動は、米国のララク島攻撃およびケルマーンシャー州におけるイスラム革命防衛隊（IRGC）要員の死亡に対する報復であるとイラン国営メディアによって説明された。

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: 一連の出来事は依然として独立した検証が困難であり、両政府はこの応酬を引き起こした原因について異なる説明を行っている。

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: 明らかなことは、事態が局地的なインシデントから、より広い地域に影響を及ぼす事態へと急速に移行したということである。

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## 報じられた内容

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: イランの当局者や国営メディアは、米国に関連する3つの基地への攻撃を、より大規模な戦争の幕開けではなく、計算された限定的な対応であると特徴づけた。これは両国間の過去の応酬のシグナル伝達のエピソードを彷彿とさせる表現である。

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: 米国の防衛当局者は湾岸地域における施設への飛来物を認めているが、犠牲者や損害の全容についてはまだ確認しておらず、評価は継続中であると慎重な姿勢を示している。

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: アナリストらは、米国の攻撃、イラン人の死傷、そして米国本土への直接攻撃ではなく米国の陣地に対するイランの抑制された対応というこのパターンが、同地域における過去の対立局面を彷彿とさせると指摘している。

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: この局面が封じ込められたままになるのか、あるいは追加のアクターを引き込むことになるのかが、ワシントン、テヘラン、そして同盟関係にある湾岸の首都の政策決定者にとっての中心的な疑問であり続けている。

segments.src: ## Markets React Instantly
segments.tr: ## 市場の即座の反応

segments.src: Financial markets moved within minutes of the news breaking.
segments.tr: 金融市場はニュース速報から数分以内に動いた。

segments.src: Benchmark oil prices climbed as traders priced in the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and production in a region that accounts for a significant share of global crude supply.
segments.tr: 世界の原油供給のかなりの割合を占める地域での輸送路や生産への混乱リスクをトレーダーが織り込むにつれ、ベンチマークの原油価格が上昇した。

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for a large portion of the world's seaborne oil trade, is once again at the center of investor concern.
segments.tr: 世界の海上原油貿易の大部分のチョークポイントであるホルムズ海峡は、再び投資家の関心の中心となっている。

segments.src: Cryptocurrency markets, often treated by traders as a barometer of risk appetite, fell sharply in tandem.
segments.tr: トレーダーによってリスク許容度のバロメーターとして扱われることが多い暗号資産市場は、連動して急落した。

segments.src: Bitcoin and other major digital assets saw notable declines as investors rotated toward traditional safe havens such as gold and the US dollar.
segments.tr: 投資家が金や米ドルなどの伝統的な安全資産へ資金を移したため、ビットコインやその他の主要なデジタル資産は顕著な下落を見せた。

segments.src: Equity futures in the US and Asia also wobbled in early trading, reflecting broader unease about the potential for a wider Gulf conflict.
segments.tr: 米国とアジアの株価指数先物も序盤の取引で動揺し、より広範な湾岸紛争の可能性に対する広範な不安を反映した。

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond the Region
segments.tr: ## 地域を超えてこれが重要である理由

segments.src: Even short of a full-scale war, sustained instability in the Gulf carries outsized economic consequences.
segments.tr: 全面戦争には至らないとしても、湾岸地域における持続的な不安定さは、桁違いの経済的影響をもたらす。

segments.src: Higher oil prices tend to filter through to fuel and transportation costs worldwide, adding pressure to inflation figures that many central banks have been working to bring down.
segments.tr: 原油価格の上昇は世界中の燃料や輸送コストに波及する傾向があり、多くの中央銀行が低下させようと取り組んできたインフレ率の数値に圧力を加えることになる。

segments.src: A prolonged standoff could also complicate diplomatic efforts elsewhere, including nuclear negotiations and regional ceasefire arrangements that have periodically stalled and restarted in recent years.
segments.tr: 長引くこう着状態は、核交渉や、近年定期的に停滞と再開を繰り返している地域の停戦合意など、他の場所での外交努力を複雑にする可能性もある。

segments.src: ## A Fluid, Fast-Moving Situation
segments.tr: ## 流動的で急速に変化する事態

segments.src: Details continue to emerge, and early reports from conflict zones are frequently revised as more information becomes available.
segments.tr: 詳細が明らかになり続けており、紛争地域からの初期の報道は、より多くの情報が入手可能になるにつれて頻繁に修正されている。

segments.src: Government spokespeople on both sides have urged caution against premature conclusions, while allied nations in the Gulf Cooperation Council have called for restraint and de-escalation.
segments.tr: 双方の政府広報担当者は早まった結論を出さないよう自制を求めており、一方で湾岸協力理事会（GCC）の同盟諸国は自制と事態の鎮静化を求めている。

segments.src: For now, markets and diplomats alike are watching for the next signal — whether from Tehran, Washington, or the bases themselves — that will determine if this remains a contained exchange or the start of a broader confrontation.
segments.tr: 現時点では、市場も外交官も同様に、これが封じ込められた応酬にとどまるのか、それともより広範な対立の始まりとなるのかを決定づける次のシグナル（テヘラン、ワシントン、あるいは基地そのものからのもの）を注視している。

segments.src: Readers should treat early casualty and damage figures as preliminary until confirmed by multiple independent sources.
segments.tr: 読者は、複数の独立した情報源によって確認されるまでは、初期の死傷者や損害の数字を暫定的なものとして扱うべきである。

de.title: Drei Stützpunkte, eine Vergeltung: Hinter den Kulissen der iranischen Angriffe auf US-Streitkräfte im Golf

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## Eine rasche Eskalation am Golf

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Die Spannungen zwischen Washington und Teheran sind in eine gefährliche neue Phase eingetreten, nachdem der Iran eine Welle von Angriffen auf US-Militäranlagen in Jordanien, Kuwait und Bahrain gestartet hat.

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: Regierungsbeamten und regionalen sowie internationalen Medienberichten zufolge wurde die Aktion von iranischen Staatsmedien als Vergeltung für einen US-Angriff auf die Insel Larak und den Tod von Personal der Islamischen Revolutionsgarde (IRGC) in der Provinz Kermanšāh bezeichnet.

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: Die Abfolge der Ereignisse lässt sich nur schwer unabhängig überprüfen, und beide Regierungen haben unterschiedliche Darstellungen darüber abgegeben, was den Schlagabtausch ausgelöst hat.

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: Klar ist jedoch, dass sich die Situation schnell von einem lokalen Zwischenfall zu einem Ereignis mit Auswirkungen auf die gesamte Region entwickelt hat.

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## Was Berichten zufolge geschah

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: Offizielle und staatsnahe Medien im Iran bezeichneten die Angriffe auf die drei mit den USA verbundenen Stützpunkte als eine kalkulierte, begrenzte Reaktion und nicht als den Eröffnungszug eines größeren Krieges – eine Sprache, die an frühere Episoden von Vergeltungssignalen zwischen den beiden Ländern erinnert.

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: US-Verteidigungsbeamte haben Beschuss von Einrichtungen in der Golfregion eingeräumt, jedoch noch nicht das volle Ausmaß von Opfern oder Schäden bestätigt und gewarnt, dass die Bewertungen noch andauern.

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: Analysten weisen darauf hin, dass dieses Muster – ein US-Angriff, iranische Opfer, gefolgt von einer kalibrierten iranischen Reaktion auf amerikanische Positionen statt direkter Angriffe auf das US-Stammland – an frühere Runden der Konfrontation in der Region erinnert.

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: Ob diese Runde eingedämmt bleibt oder weitere Akteure einbezieht, bleibt die zentrale Frage für politische Entscheidungsträger in Washington, Teheran und verbündeten Golf-Hauptstädten.

segments.src: ## Markets React Instantly
segments.tr: ## Märkte reagieren umgehend

segments.src: Financial markets moved within minutes of the news breaking.
segments.tr: Die Finanzmärkte bewegten sich wenige Minuten nach Bekanntwerden der Nachricht.

segments.src: Benchmark oil prices climbed as traders priced in the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and production in a region that accounts for a significant share of global crude supply.
segments.tr: Die Ölreferenzpreise kletterten, da Händler das Risiko von Störungen der Schifffahrtswege und der Produktion in einer Region einpreisten, die einen bedeutenden Anteil der weltweiten Rohölversorgung ausmacht.

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for a large portion of the world's seaborne oil trade, is once again at the center of investor concern.
segments.tr: Die Straße von Hormus, ein Nadelöhr für einen großen Teil des weltweiten Öltransports auf dem Seeweg, steht erneut im Zentrum der Sorgen von Investoren.

segments.src: Cryptocurrency markets, often treated by traders as a barometer of risk appetite, fell sharply in tandem.
segments.tr: Kryptowährermärkte, die von Händlern oft als Barometer für die Risikobereitschaft angesehen werden, fielen im Einklang stark.

segments.src: Bitcoin and other major digital assets saw notable declines as investors rotated toward traditional safe havens such as gold and the US dollar.
segments.tr: Bitcoin und andere wichtige digitale Vermögenswerte verzeichneten deutliche Rückgänge, da Anleger in traditionelle sichere Häfen wie Gold und den US-Dollar umschichteten.

segments.src: Equity futures in the US and Asia also wobbled in early trading, reflecting broader unease about the potential for a wider Gulf conflict.
segments.tr: Aktienfutures in den USA und Asien gerieten im frühen Handel ebenfalls ins Wanken und spiegelten die breitere Verunsicherung über das Potenzial eines größeren Golfkonflikts wider.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond the Region
segments.tr: ## Warum dies über die Region hinaus wichtig ist

segments.src: Even short of a full-scale war, sustained instability in the Gulf carries outsized economic consequences.
segments.tr: Selbst ohne einen umfassenden Krieg hat eine anhaltende Instabilität am Golf übergroße wirtschaftliche Folgen.

segments.src: Higher oil prices tend to filter through to fuel and transportation costs worldwide, adding pressure to inflation figures that many central banks have been working to bring down.
segments.tr: Höhere Ölpreise schlagen tendenziell auf die Treibstoff- und Transportkosten weltweit durch und erhöhen den Druck auf die Inflationszahlen, die viele Zentralbanken zu senken versucht haben.

segments.src: A prolonged standoff could also complicate diplomatic efforts elsewhere, including nuclear negotiations and regional ceasefire arrangements that have periodically stalled and restarted in recent years.
segments.tr: Eine langwierige Pattsituation könnte auch diplomatische Bemühungen an anderer Stelle erschweren, darunter Nuklearverhandlungen und regionale Waffenstillstandsvereinbarungen, die in den letzten Jahren periodisch ins Stocken geraten und neu gestartet wurden.

segments.tr: ## Eine fließende, sich schnell entwickelnde Situation

segments.src: Details continue to emerge, and early reports from conflict zones are frequently revised as more information becomes available.
segments.tr: Details tauchen weiterhin auf, und frühe Berichte aus Konfliktzonen werden häufig revidiert, sobald weitere Informationen verfügbar sind.

segments.src: Government spokespeople on both sides have urged caution against premature conclusions, while allied nations in the Gulf Cooperation Council have called for restraint and de-escalation.
segments.tr: Regierungssprecher beider Seiten haben zur Vorsicht vor verfrühten Schlüssen aufgerufen, während verbündete Nationen des Kooperationsrates der arabischen Staaten des Golfs zu Besonnenheit und Deeskalation aufgerufen haben.

segments.src: For now, markets and diplomats alike are watching for the next signal — whether from Tehran, Washington, or the bases themselves — that will determine if this remains a contained exchange or the start of a broader confrontation.
segments.tr: Vorerst warten Märkte und Diplomaten gleichermaßen auf das nächste Signal – sei es aus Teheran, Washington oder von den Stützpunkten selbst –, das bestimmen wird, ob dies ein eingedämmter Schlagabtausch oder der Beginn einer breiteren Konfrontation bleibt.

segments.src: Readers should treat early casualty and damage figures as preliminary until confirmed by multiple independent sources.
segments.tr: Leser sollten frühe Zahlen zu Opfern und Schäden als vorläufig betrachten, bis sie von mehreren unabhängigen Quellen bestätigt wurden.

vi.title: Ba căn cứ, một cuộc trả đũa: Bắt đầu từ các cuộc tấn công của Iran vào lực lượng Mỹ ở Vùng Vịnh

segments.src: ## A Rapid Escalation in the Gulf
segments.tr: ## Sự leo thang nhanh chóng ở Vùng Vịnh

segments.src: Tensions between Washington and Tehran have entered a dangerous new phase after Iran launched a wave of strikes targeting American military installations in Jordan, Kuwait and Bahrain.
segments.tr: Căng thẳng giữa Washington và Tehran đã bước vào một giai đoạn mới đầy nguy hiểm sau khi Iran phát động một làn sóng tấn công nhằm vào các cơ sở quân sự của Mỹ ở Jordan, Kuwait và Bahrain.

segments.src: According to officials cited by regional and international outlets, the action was described by Iranian state media as retaliation for a US strike on Larak Island and the deaths of Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) personnel in Kermanshah province.
segments.tr: Theo các quan chức được dẫn lời bởi các cơ quan truyền thông khu vực và quốc tế, hành động này được truyền thông nhà nước Iran mô tả là sự trả đũa cho cuộc tấn công của Mỹ vào đảo Larak và cái chết của các nhân sự Quân đoàn Vệ binh Cách mạng Hồi giáo (IRGC) ở tỉnh Kermanshah.

segments.src: The sequence of events remains difficult to verify independently, and both governments have offered differing accounts of what triggered the exchange.
segments.tr: Trình tự các sự kiện vẫn khó xác minh một cách độc lập, và chính phủ cả hai nước đều đưa ra những báo cáo khác nhau về nguyên nhân kích hoạt cuộc trao đổi đòn tấn công này.

segments.src: What is clear is that the situation has moved quickly from a localized incident to one with implications for the broader region.
segments.tr: Điều rõ ràng là tình hình đã nhanh chóng chuyển từ một sự cố cục bộ sang một sự kiện có ảnh hưởng đến toàn bộ khu vực rộng lớn hơn.

segments.src: ## What Reportedly Happened
segments.tr: ## Báo cáo về những gì đã xảy ra

segments.src: Officials and state-affiliated media in Iran characterized the strikes on the three US-linked bases as a calculated, limited response rather than the opening move of a wider war — language reminiscent of past episodes of tit-for-tat signaling between the two countries.
segments.tr: Các quan chức và truyền thông liên kết với nhà nước ở Iran mô tả các cuộc tấn công vào ba căn cứ liên quan đến Mỹ là một phản ứng có tính toán, hạn chế chứ không phải là bước mở đầu của một cuộc chiến rộng lớn hơn — ngôn từ gợi nhớ đến các giai đoạn trả đũa ăn miếng trả miếng trước đây giữa hai nước.

segments.src: US defense officials have acknowledged incoming fire at facilities in the Gulf region but have not yet confirmed the full scope of casualties or damage, cautioning that assessments are ongoing.
segments.tr: Các quan chức quốc phòng Mỹ đã thừa nhận việc các cơ sở ở khu vực Vùng Vịnh bị hỏa lực nhắm tới nhưng vẫn chưa xác nhận quy mô đầy đủ về thiệt hại về người hoặc tài sản, đồng thời cảnh báo rằng các đánh giá vẫn đang được tiến hành.

segments.src: Analysts note that this pattern — a US strike, Iranian casualties, then a calibrated Iranian response against American positions rather than direct strikes on the US homeland — has echoes of previous rounds of confrontation in the region.
segments.tr: Các nhà phân tích lưu ý rằng mô hình này — một cuộc tấn công của Mỹ, thương vong phía Iran, sau đó là phản ứng được tính toán kỹ lưỡng của Iran nhằm vào các vị trí của Mỹ thay vì tấn công trực tiếp vào lãnh thổ Mỹ — có nét tương đồng với các vòng đối đầu trước đây trong khu vực.

segments.src: Whether this round stays contained or draws in additional actors remains the central question for policymakers in Washington, Tehran, and allied Gulf capitals.
segments.tr: Việc vòng đối đầu này được kiềm chế hay lôi kéo thêm các bên khác vẫn là câu hỏi trung tâm đối với các nhà hoạch định chính sách ở Washington, Tehran và thủ đô của các đồng minh Vùng Vịnh.

segments.src: ## Markets React Instantly
segments.tr: ## Thị trường phản ứng ngay lập tức

segments.src: Financial markets moved within minutes of the news breaking.
segments.tr: Thị trường tài chính đã biến động chỉ trong vòng vài phút sau khi tin tức nổ ra.

segments.src: Benchmark oil prices climbed as traders priced in the risk of disruption to shipping lanes and production in a region that accounts for a significant share of global crude supply.
segments.tr: Giá dầu chuẩn tăng lên khi các thương nhân tính đến rủi ro gián đoạn các tuyến đường vận tải biển và hoạt động sản xuất tại một khu vực chiếm tỷ trọng đáng kể trong nguồn cung dầu mỏ toàn cầu.

segments.src: The Strait of Hormuz, a chokepoint for a large portion of the world's seaborne oil trade, is once again at the center of investor concern.
segments.tr: Eo biển Hormuz, điểm nghẽn của một phần lớn thương mại dầu mỏ đường biển trên thế giới, một lần nữa trở thành tâm điểm lo ngại của các nhà đầu tư.

segments.src: Cryptocurrency markets, often treated by traders as a barometer of risk appetite, fell sharply in tandem.
segments.tr: Thị trường tiền điện tử, vốn thường được các nhà giao dịch coi là thước đo khẩu vị rủi ro, cũng giảm mạnh đồng thời.

segments.src: Bitcoin and other major digital assets saw notable declines as investors rotated toward traditional safe havens such as gold and the US dollar.
segments.tr: Bitcoin và các tài sản kỹ thuật số lớn khác đã ghi nhận mức giảm đáng kể khi các nhà đầu tư dịch chuyển sang các tài sản trú ẩn an toàn truyền thống như vàng và đô la Mỹ.

segments.src: Equity futures in the US and Asia also wobbled in early trading, reflecting broader unease about the potential for a wider Gulf conflict.
segments.tr: Hợp đồng tương lai cổ phiếu ở Mỹ và Châu Á cũng chao đảo trong phiên giao dịch sớm, phản ánh sự bất an rộng hơn về khả năng xảy ra một cuộc xung đột rộng lớn hơn ở Vùng Vịnh.

segments.src: ## Why This Matters Beyond the Region
segments.tr: ## Tại sao điều này lại quan trọng ngoài phạm vi khu vực

segments.src: Even short of a full-scale war, sustained instability in the Gulf carries outsized economic consequences.
segments.tr: Ngay cả khi không xảy ra một cuộc chiến tranh toàn diện, sự mất ổn định kéo dài ở Vùng Vịnh vẫn mang lại những hậu quả kinh tế to lớn.

segments.src: Higher oil prices tend to filter through to fuel and transportation costs worldwide, adding pressure to inflation figures that many central banks have been working to bring down.
segments.tr: Giá dầu cao hơn có xu hướng lan sang chi phí nhiên liệu và vận tải trên toàn thế giới, gia tăng áp lực lên chỉ số lạm phát mà nhiều ngân hàng trung ương đã nỗ lực kéo xuống.

segments.src: A prolonged standoff could also complicate diplomatic efforts elsewhere, including nuclear negotiations and regional ceasefire arrangements that have periodically stalled and restarted in recent years.
segments.tr: Sự bế tắc kéo dài cũng có thể làm phức tạp các nỗ lực ngoại giao ở những nơi khác, bao gồm các cuộc đàm phán hạt nhân và các thỏa thuận ngừng bắn khu vực vốn thỉnh thoảng bị đình trệ và khởi động lại trong những năm gần đây.

segments.src: ## A Fluid, Fast-Moving Situation
segments.tr: ## Một tình hình biến động và chuyển biến nhanh chóng

segments.src: Details continue to emerge, and early reports from conflict zones are frequently revised as more information becomes available.
segments.tr: Các chi tiết tiếp tục xuất hiện, và các báo cáo ban đầu từ các vùng chiến sự thường xuyên được điều chỉnh khi có thêm thông tin.

segments.src: Government spokespeople on both sides have urged caution against premature conclusions, while allied nations in the Gulf Cooperation Council have called for restraint and de-escalation.
segments.tr: Người phát ngôn chính phủ của cả hai bên đã kêu gọi thận trọng đối với các kết luận vội vàng, trong khi các quốc gia đồng minh trong Hội đồng Hợp tác Vùng Vịnh đã kêu gọi kiềm chế và hạ nhiệt căng thẳng.

segments.src: For now, markets and diplomats alike are watching for the next signal — whether from Tehran, Washington, or the bases themselves — that will determine if this remains a contained exchange or the start of a broader confrontation.
segments.tr: Hiện tại, các thị trường cũng như các nhà ngoại giao đang theo dõi tín hiệu tiếp theo — dù là từ Tehran, Washington hay chính các căn cứ — điều sẽ quyết định xem đây có tiếp tục là một cuộc trao đổi đòn tấn công được kiềm chế hay là sự bắt đầu của một cuộc đối đầu rộng lớn hơn.

segments.src: Readers should treat early casualty and damage figures as preliminary until confirmed by multiple independent sources.
segments.tr: Độc giả nên coi các số liệu ban đầu về thương vong và thiệt hại là sơ bộ cho đến khi được xác nhận bởi nhiều nguồn độc lập.
